notes.title: 📢 Update 0.3.1
notes.notes:
📌Language Support
Added Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, and Japanese.

Translations were applied using AI and internal review. If you find any incorrect translations, please contact us via the Steam forum or Discord; we will verify and fix them.
[hr][/hr]📌Improvements & Fixes
Revised and improved mission-related interaction systems.

Fixed an issue where all creature attack animations were not properly synchronized.

Improved the precision of all creatures’ attack ranges.

Adjusted creature blood to adhere more consistently to terrain.

notes.title: 📢 0.3.0 Minor Patch
notes.notes:
📌 Improvements & Additions
 Improved creature pathfinding performance when moving vertically.

 Added terminal icons to the map.

notes.title: 📢 Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
📌 Improvements & Additions


Added 2 new types of infected creatures!


Set a maximum spawn limit to prevent creatures from endlessly spawning from spawners.


Optimized overall creature AI performance.




All primary and secondary weapons now display a laser sight when aiming.


Unified and improved knockback animation ranges across all weapons.




Stage maps now only reveal areas the player has explored.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/32234752c672117cbff95daf5a81f2bfba82c00e.gif"]


Because zone numbers can no longer be previewed, visual markers have been placed to help players infer each zone.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/4017ccc90daac576553ddd3b322eec5fba157599.png"]






Adjusted the minimum and maximum zoom levels of the map camera.


Added experimental bullet ricochet mechanics based on the angle of impact.


[hr][/hr]
📌 Notice on Chinese & Russian Language Support
Font compatibility

We aimed to roll out multilingual support (including Chinese and Russian) quickly, but our current pixel fonts Galmuri 9 / Galmuri 11 do not fully support these character sets and readability is poor.


Therefore, we will switch to a more legible font and apply it in the next update. While it won’t be a pixel-style font, this change is necessary to clearly display multiple languages. We will also continue exploring ways to improve the original pixel fonts for multilingual use.

[hr][/hr]
China server connectivity

We currently use Photon servers, and our base plan does not include a China region server. As a result, many players in China connect to Korea, Japan, or other Asia servers, which can cause matchmaking delays and latency.


We are actively evaluating options to add and connect a China server so players in China can enjoy a smoother experience.


We apologize for the inconvenience, and these issues will be addressed progressively in upcoming updates.

notes.title: 📢 0.2.8 Minor Patch
notes.notes:
Improvements & Additions
Updated the images and positions of map icons and item icons on the in-game map.

Replaced some environment graphics in specific areas.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the player could slip on stairs.

Fixed an issue where controls would not respond when playing on some laptops.

notes.title: 📢 Update 0.2.8
notes.notes:
Improvements & Additions
Chat feature added to the lobby.
Click the chat icon to communicate with your squad members!

Ready check system added to the lobby.
The squad leader can now start the mission only after all members are marked as ready.

Item quantity now adjusts automatically based on the number of deployed players.

Damage number effects have been added when you shoot at a creature's weak point while aiming directly at it.

Improved the issue where no additional creatures would spawn after reaching the maximum spawn limit.

Creatures now also slow down when stepping into chemical container liquid.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where keyboard input didn't work when a controller was connected at game launch.
(Note: This fix is not yet fully verified and will continue to be monitored.)

Fixed areas where difficulty scaling based on squad size was not properly applied.

Fixed a bug where objects with health did not display their HP values correctly during missions.

Fixed a bug in RD2 where the camera would not move in a specific location.
[hr][/hr]Known Issues
These issues do not occur every time but have been reported by some players:

In some parties, after boarding the extraction shuttle in RD2, the character disappears and the player cannot take any actions.

In some cases, after changing servers, attempting to create a room fails and controls become unresponsive.

In some parties, severe delay occurs when a specific player is the host, even if all players are in the same region.

Temporary workaround: Change the host and reconnect to the game. However, this may not always resolve the issue. We apologize for the inconvenience and will fix these issues as soon as the cause is identified.

notes.title: 📢 Update 0.2.6 - Latency fix
notes.notes:
Improvements & Additions
Fixed and improved a severe multiplayer delay issue that made the game nearly unplayable.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/4a63048f43d42c76141de494d554fc6867ceb2e5.png"]
Your server region and ping are now displayed at the bottom of the main screen.

If you can’t see your friend in the lobby list, make sure you both set the same server region.

The previous issue where the escape shuttle could not be interacted with may be related to latency, so
(The issue where players couldn't interact with the extraction shuttle may be related to this delay — further testing is appreciated.)





Lobby Features Added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/04d66d92239f469905b8d891a73626e1bb1cefa3.png"]Added the ability to set lobbies as public or private when creating them.

You can now name your lobby.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44245802/ec950bc0dd48d0c16ad92c53eee6b70540364b37.png"]To join a private lobby, enter its name in the Lobby ID field when joining.



Improved several English translations (weapon descriptions, main menu, options, etc.).


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue in RD2 where sound would not play in specific areas.

Fixed a bug in RD2 where the camera view would suddenly drop downward in certain spots.

Fixed an issue where shooting would stop when clicking UI during fire.

Fixed an issue where the “out of ammo” warning was always displayed in Korean, regardless of selected language.

Adjusted interaction text for supply crates and items.

Resolution crop settings now also apply to the main menu.



Fixed the issue where difficulty spiked to unplayable levels in 4-player mode. However, since our testing data is limited, we need your help to verify this!!!




Known Issues
We are currently investigating a bug where keyboard and mouse input do not work if a controller is connected when launching the game.
This issue is expected to be resolved alongside upcoming improvements to controller input handling.

notes.title: 📢 Update 0.2.5
notes.notes:
Improvements & Additions
Increased the item drop rate from crates across all stages.

Adjusted the location of the extraction dropship in RD1.

Extended the wave intervals during the RD1 extraction mission.

Increased the health of the research machine in the RD2 defense mission.

Reduced the time it takes for the extraction dropship to arrive in RD2.

Extended the wave intervals during the RD2 extraction mission.

Extended the wave intervals during the generator mission in RD3.

[spoiler]Improved lighting in RD3 when the laboratory lights are turned off (it was too dark).[/spoiler]


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue in RD3 where the camera would suddenly tilt downward in certain areas.

Fixed an issue in RD3 where some special infected would clump together during the bioscan mission.

Fixed a bug where switching back to your primary weapon was not possible while holding a grenade.

notes.title: 📢 Update 0.2.4
notes.notes:
Improvements & Additions
Improved English translations.

Added a new stage.

Added Japanese translations. (Still incomplete.)

Added BGM. (There was no music before—wow!)

Breaking specific boxes now drops random items.

Greatly reduced the volume of the siren sound.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where selecting English caused text to not display correctly or be mixed with other languages.
(If you find additional translation errors, please report them on our Discord!)

Fixed an issue where the keycard mission in RD1 would not complete properly.

Fixed an issue where clearing RD1 did not unlock the next stages.
Known Issues
In multiplayer, if each player selects a different language, in-game text may appear mixed.

If you are not the host and your internet connection is unstable, the game may disconnect.

If concurrent users exceed 100, connecting to the server may not be possible.
